text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear stated opposition in the opening and closing","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay maintains a consistent position against driverless cars and returns to that claim throughout the piece."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on roadwork, distracted drivers, and liability laws","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay uses several relevant details from the article to back up its claim rather than relying on general opinion."},{"evidence":"explains why backup systems can fail and why accidents could result","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"The essay more fully explains how each article detail leads to a negative consequence."},{"evidence":"third paragraph develops the problem of new laws and responsibility","quality":"organization of ideas","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct points that build on one another in a clear progression."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates multiple dangers and ties them to confusion","quality":"conclusion development","description":"The ending does more than repeat the position by summarizing the main reasons and reinforcing the final claim."}]}
